verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a REST API and an MCP server that "expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app" [docs-16, docs-29], and its API page covers automated searches and citation integration [docs-1, docs-15]. That shows parity for core search and synthesis. The evidence only shows API access for those capabilities, not for the many other UI features, so full UI parity is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: API coverage of Library import/management (Zotero/BibTeX/RIS/PDF), Citation Graph, Deep Search, Threads, Medical Mode, filters and Consensus Meter via API, published API reference docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
